def to_file(self, filename=None, write_style=True):
        """
        >>> p = Preso()
        >>> z = p.to_file('/tmp/foo.odp')
        >>> sorted(z.ls('/'))
        ['META-INF/manifest.xml', 'content.xml', 'meta.xml', 'mimetype', 'settings.xml', 'styles.xml']
        """
        if filename is None:
            filename = self.filename
        if filename is None:
            raise ValueError('no filename given')
        if not filename.endswith('.odp'):
            filename += '.odp'
        if not os.path.exists(filename):
            os.makedirs(filename)
        if write_style:
            self.write_style(filename)
        self.write_content(filename)
        self.write_meta(filename)
        self.write_settings(filename)
        self.write_manifest(filename)
        self.write_mimetype(filename)
        return self
